supported: hierarchical GPU/host/storage cache paths exist in the inspected SGLang source
host load-back and asynchronous transfer completion are real mechanisms
a sidecar event envelope is feasible without mutating engine ownership
unverified_or_proxy: arbitrary cancellation of in-flight cache transfers

required_events: prefix identity, model/layout/component and exact matched tokens
gpu_gate.correctness: cached and no-cache replay outputs must match; stale/canceled transfers cannot count as hits
gpu_gate.target_regime: simulator GPU 1000-2400 token-equivalents and bandwidth 200-400 regime
gpu_gate.stop_condition: if required events cannot be collected, report feasibility only and do not rent multi-hour GPU time
